message.skyabyss.tower.not_yet: Something seems to stand in the plaza. ...You can't see it yet.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.hello: The tower desk. At the end of the bridge between sky and abyss, a colossal master waits. Challenge it as a squad. One entry per person per day.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.used: You already entered the tower today. It rearranges at 5 a.m.
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.cannot_join: You can't join that squad (only by the desk, and only if you haven't entered today).
message.skyabyss.tower.desk.left_behind: You weren't by the desk, so you didn't enter this time.
message.skyabyss.tower.full: The tower is crowded right now. Wait a little.
message.skyabyss.tower.wipe: No one is left standing on the bridge. The tower pushes the squad back. ...That is all for today.
message.skyabyss.tower.woke: You woke in the rest area at the bridge entrance.
message.skyabyss.tower.title: The Tower Between
message.skyabyss.tower.sub: The bridge between sky and abyss — squad of %s
message.skyabyss.tower.fell: You nearly fell from the bridge and were pulled back to the entrance.
message.skyabyss.tower.timeout: Time ran out. The master chants the rewinding and the bridge unravels into white. ...That is all for today.
message.skyabyss.tower.intro: Beyond the bridge, the One Seated Between raises its head. Head north to strike it.
message.skyabyss.tower.swarm: A swarm floods the bridge. Binders on the side platforms heal the master: kill them first.
message.skyabyss.tower.stoke: The pull grows. A scale sigil opens above the horns: the master hits harder and faster.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon: A falling moon rolls south. Break it before the bridge's end; the master is immune till then.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon_gone: The falling moon shatters. The master can be hurt again.
message.skyabyss.tower.moon_lost: The falling moon crossed the bridge. The world rewinds in white... Today's attempt ends here.
message.skyabyss.tower.arrows: Three heavenly arrows mark %s. Spread for the first, gather for the rest.
message.skyabyss.tower.sigil: A red ring is chasing you. Keep running in circles.
message.skyabyss.tower.exhort: The repelling voice. You were close to the master: pushed back, mana drained.
message.skyabyss.tower.phlegm: Struck by a chain child: healing is weaker for a while.
message.skyabyss.tower.cleared: The One Seated Between collapses. You have crossed the tower. (%s)
message.skyabyss.tower.clear_back: You will return to the capital desk shortly.
item.skyabyss.tower_shard.desc: A shard of mixed white and black, left after the tower's master falls. Fuel for tower gear (resonance forge) and the tower shop's price.
item.skyabyss.box.kind_tower: Tower box · gear of the Tower Between (all mythic)
item.skyabyss.tower_balance_sword.desc: Half sky, half abyss. "Scales of Sky and Abyss": above half health, +30% damage; at half or below, heal 25% of damage dealt. Drawback: healing from other sources -50%.
item.skyabyss.tower_balance_sword.story: "Whichever way it tips, the blade does not break."
item.skyabyss.tower_pull_hammer.desc: A hammer forged from the pull itself. "Gravity": every 4th hit drags foes within 8 to your feet and strikes them for 200% attack (large foes are hit but not pulled). Drawback: movement speed -10%.
item.skyabyss.tower_pull_hammer.story: "The pull between sky and abyss, driven into one head."
item.skyabyss.tower_moon_staff.desc: A staff holding a falling moon. "New Moon": every third skill that lands drops a small moon on the target (250% attack within 4). Drawback: skill mana cost +20%.
item.skyabyss.tower_moon_staff.story: "The smallest shard of a moon that never crossed the bridge."
item.skyabyss.tower_eye_bow.desc: A bow set with a watching eye. "Fixed Gaze": each consecutive hit on the same foe adds +10% (up to +100% at 10); hitting another foe resets it. Drawback: Cloud Pierce no longer pierces.
item.skyabyss.tower_eye_bow.story: "The eye watches only one. The one it watches cannot flee."
item.skyabyss.tower_sigil_dagger.desc: A dagger etched with the chasing sigil. "Hunting Sigil": the first foe you hit is marked (the mark stays). Marked foe takes +40%; killing it resets all skill cooldowns. Drawback: -20% damage to unmarked foes.
item.skyabyss.tower_sigil_dagger.story: "The red ring burns those who stop. So keep running."
item.skyabyss.tower_clap_bell_staff.desc: A bell staff of joined palms. "Joined Palms": each hit adds a prayer; at 5, allies within 8 (and you) recover 30% health and take -20% damage for 6 s. Drawback: your melee damage -25%.
item.skyabyss.tower_clap_bell_staff.stor: "Join your hands, and a small sound rings between sky and abyss."
item.skyabyss.tower_scale.desc: Heavy set. 4 pieces: damage taken x0.90; +12 toughness while at half health or below
item.skyabyss.tower_bridge.desc: Light set. 4 pieces: +10% speed; damage taken x0.90 while sprinting
item.skyabyss.tower_halo.desc: Arcane set. 4 pieces: +40% mana regeneration, skill cooldowns -8%
item.skyabyss.tower_heaven_ring.desc: A gold ring with spread white feathers. While at full health: +8% damage dealt.
item.skyabyss.tower_heaven_ring.story: "Only the full may reach for the sky."
item.skyabyss.tower_abyss_chain.desc: A chain of black stone links. At 30% health or below: damage taken x0.80.
item.skyabyss.tower_abyss_chain.story: "The abyss holds on to those about to fall."
message.skyabyss.tower.box: A Tower Box dropped! Open it at a box opener (it holds one mythic piece).
message.skyabyss.tower.wager.head: This week's wagers (up to three; each +%s%% shards):
message.skyabyss.tower.records.head: ― Tower Between: fastest by squad size ―
message.skyabyss.tower.record: New fastest record for %s players! Your names are on the desk's board.
message.skyabyss.tower.wager.half_heal.d: Inside the tower, potions and skills restore only half.
message.skyabyss.tower.wager.no_revive.d: Fallen allies cannot be revived; they must wake and return from the entrance.
message.skyabyss.tower.wager.fast_moon.d: The falling moon crosses in three quarters of the time.
message.skyabyss.tower.wager.hard_eyes.d: The side eyes cannot be destroyed; only cover helps.
secret.skyabyss.second_cut.desc: After Titan Cleave, a second cut 0.5s later (x0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 weapon damage).
secret.skyabyss.quake_call.desc: Rock Call slows foes within 4 of the target (2 / 3 / 4s).
secret.skyabyss.whale_whirl.desc: Whale Sweep pulls in foes within 5 and hits them (x0.3 / 0.45 / 0.6).
secret.skyabyss.blade_storm.desc: Spin Cut spins again every 0.4s (1 / 1 / 2 times, x0.35).
secret.skyabyss.shadow_step.desc: Lunge leaves a shadow that bursts after 1s (x0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 within 3).
secret.skyabyss.caltrops.desc: Backstep leaves caltrops (slow, x0.2 per second within 2.5, for 3 / 4 / 5s).
secret.skyabyss.chasing_blades.desc: Wind Rend sends wind blades at foes within 6 (2 / 3 / 4 blades, x0.3).
secret.skyabyss.double_fang.desc: Twin Fang bites the nearest foe once more (x0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8).
secret.skyabyss.ward_echo.desc: 2s after Ward Song, allies within 6 heal again (20 / 30 / 40).
secret.skyabyss.maelstrom.desc: Ebb Tide leaves a 3s whirlpool (pulls foes, spell x0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 per second).
secret.skyabyss.curse_spread.desc: Curse Mark spreads to foes within 6 (1 / 2 / 3; weakness 4s and spell x0.3).
secret.skyabyss.lamp_blessing.desc: Lamp Charm gives allies within 6 an absorption ward (20 / 30 / 40 health).
secret.skyabyss.afterheat.desc: Temper sets foes within 4 ablaze (2 / 3 / 4s) and hits for x0.2.
secret.skyabyss.double_hammer.desc: 0.6s after Ember Hammer, it strikes the same spot again (x0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 within 3).
secret.skyabyss.ash_veil.desc: Ash Scatter slows and weakens foes within 5 (3 / 4 / 5s).
secret.skyabyss.forge_pulse.desc: Forge Stomp sends aftershocks every 0.5s (2 / 3 / 3 times, x0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 within 4).
secret.skyabyss.split_arrows.desc: Cloud Pierce splits toward foes within 8 of the target (2 / 3 / 4 arrows, x0.3).
secret.skyabyss.linked_trap.desc: 1.5s after Bone Trap, foes within 3 of the spot are slowed and hit (x0.3 / 0.45 / 0.6).
secret.skyabyss.lingering_rain.desc: Sky Rain lingers (2 / 3 / 4s, x0.2 to one foe within 5 each second).
secret.skyabyss.hawk_landing.desc: 1s after Archer Leap, landing hits within 3 (x0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8) and grants speed for 3s.
secret.skyabyss.chain_bolt.desc: Thunder Bolt chains to more foes (1 / 2 / 3, spell x0.4).
secret.skyabyss.ember_ground.desc: Ember Orb leaves burning ground for 3s (spell x0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 per second).
secret.skyabyss.frost_bite.desc: After Frost Tide, foes within 6 take +15% / 20% / 25% damage for 4s.
secret.skyabyss.star_trail.desc: Blink leaves a star that bursts after 1s (spell x0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 within 3).
item.skyabyss.secret_scroll.desc: Holds one secret art that adds to a skill of your current job. Reading raises its tier (up to III).
message.skyabyss.secret.over: "%s" is already mastered. The scroll became %s Tower Shards.
message.skyabyss.secret.head: ― Secret arts (slots %s / %s; only slotted arts work) ―
message.skyabyss.secret.none: No secret arts yet. Read a Secret Art Scroll.
message.skyabyss.tower.scroll: Found a Secret Art Scroll. Use it to learn a secret art.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_tower_keeper: ...Welcome. I am the Tower Keeper, warden of this end of the bridge between sky and abyss. Only those who chose an ending may enter.
Form a squad, or trade your shards?

One entry a day; the tower rearranges at the fifth hour. Defeat the master past the bridge for shards and coins, and with luck a tower box. Take on the week's wagers for more shards. If the moon crosses the bridge, it is over.
gui.skyabyss.skill.change.head: Current changes:
gui.skyabyss.skill.arts_title: Secret art slots (only slotted arts work)
gui.skyabyss.skill.arts_hint: Click to list secret arts (slot/remove) in chat
item.skyabyss.tower_scale_helmet.story: The balance helm tilts toward neither side.
item.skyabyss.tower_scale_chestplate.sto: On the chest's two pans: one heaven, one abyss.
item.skyabyss.tower_scale_leggings.story: The more the wounds, the deeper the legs take root.
item.skyabyss.tower_scale_boots.story: When the tower floor tilts, these boots do not.
item.skyabyss.tower_bridge_helmet.story: Whoever crosses the bridge looks only ahead.
item.skyabyss.tower_bridge_chestplate.st: A light vest woven from the links of the bridge chain.
item.skyabyss.tower_bridge_leggings.stor: Stop and you fall. So the legs never stop.
item.skyabyss.tower_bridge_boots.story: The soles still hold the chill of the bridge stones.
item.skyabyss.tower_halo_helmet.story: The halo settles on the head of one who thinks.
item.skyabyss.tower_halo_chestplate.stor: The robe's feathers fell from the rim of the gate the master carries.
item.skyabyss.tower_halo_leggings.story: The words of prayer are sewn into the hem.
item.skyabyss.tower_halo_boots.story: Walk on light and your feet lift a little.
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.title: The Tower Between — Desk
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.ready: You can still enter the tower today.
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.used: You already entered today (resets at 5 AM).
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.rule: Once a day. Squads of 1-12. The leader presses Enter Tower.
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.hint: Create a squad and your party members near the desk join too.
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.wagers: This week's wagers (up to %s, +%s%% shards each): %s
message.skyabyss.tower.intro_sub: The pull of sky and abyss, given form
message.skyabyss.tower.tip1: Red floor marks warn of attacks: leave before they fill. Pale blue marks split the damage among everyone inside.
message.skyabyss.tower.tip2: At 50% and 20% health a Falling Moon crosses the bridge southward. Break it (aim at its center) before it reaches the south end.
message.skyabyss.tower.tip3: The side eyes on the ledges fire beams and can be broken. Kill the binders that heal the master first.
message.skyabyss.tower.tip4: The gold ring at the entrance heals you. Falling off the bridge returns you there and costs 20% of your health.
message.skyabyss.tower.announce_enter: [Tower Between] %1$s's squad (%2$s) has entered the tower.
message.skyabyss.tower.announce_clear: [Tower Between] %1$s's squad drove back the One Seated Between (%2$s).
message.skyabyss.tower.clear_sub: The One Seated Between is gone beyond the gate (%s)
message.skyabyss.tower.stance.star.desc: more Stardust Rain from the start, Heaven's Three Arrows sooner
gui.skyabyss.tower_desk.rule_stance: Once a day · squads of 1-12. This week: %s
message.skyabyss.tower.mark: Triple Wager mark (week %s): a tower box this week
